notes.title: ROBOBEAT is OUT NOW.
notes.notes:
Hello! My new game ROBOBEAT is out now.
It’s a rhythm movement shooter. And I think it’s very fun!
Maybe some of you will like it too.
Please check it out if you want. 


Kevin said BTG is better, but he gives ROBOBEAT a solid 9/10.

There's also a bundle with ULTRAKILL and DUSK!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/

notes.title: This game's future
notes.notes:
Hey, 

When I released this game, I never thought the game would get this amount of downloads. I'm incredibly grateful for all the comments. You helped me through a tough time. Seriously, thanks.

You might wonder about the future of this game and why the game haven’t been updated. I’ve not been communicating at all. So here we go.

The game’s been out for a long time. And is still not playable on certain computers. I’m really sorry about this, maybe even a bit ashamed.

I released the game at the same time as I started my second year in college. Which meant that I had very little time to spend from that point and forward. As you might know, the game runs on a engine that I made from scratch. Even though I learned a lot, it also came with a lot of bugs..

So, a crappy engine, not enough knowledge and no time to spend. I had to choose between working on episode 1 or schoolwork everyday. This later resulted in me almost being dropped completely from school. Episode 1’s release date’s closing in and I have barely 50% of my minimum requirements complete. It wasn’t going to work. I had to get my shit together, I stopped working on the game and put all my time into collage instead.

So Episode 1 never got completed. 

But,
The game is not dead.
I’ve learned so much.
Kevin will be back.
The game ís going to be made into something more advanced, in every aspect.

I will go full time when I finish my last year of school.
I hope you’ll stick around.

Twitter: @Insanity_Games_

Simon
